Stereotype.name: OWLDefiniton
Stereotype.notes: Ontology Definition Diagrams describe the ontology in terms of the classes, properties and relationships used to formally describe ontology concepts.

Stereotype.name: OWLFacts
Stereotype.notes: Ontology Facts Diagrams describe the ontology in terms of the facts, based on the individual ontology class instances, that describe the knowledge base.

Stereotype.name: RDFDefinition
Stereotype.notes: Resource Definition Diagrams describe metadata used in defining ontologies.

Model.name: Simple OWL Ontology
Model.description: Create a simple Ontology model containing formal definitions and facts using OWL

Model.name: Simple RDF Document
Model.description: Create a simple Resource Description Document using RDF
